posts.title: Tennis by the book
posts.description: Cervantes plays with us. posts.title: Bou-strophedon
posts.description: Boustrophedon literally means “ox-turning”, referring to the way an ox-driven plough (or any plough for that matter) will do its work, going one way down the field and when it gets to the end turning round through 180° and going back next to the first furrow.
